blocks.text: Architecting an Automated IT Integration for a Solar Energy Pioneer
Energy
Client
A pioneer and industry leader in solar energy in India, part of a multi-billion dollar conglomerate.
Ambition
To execute a complex merger of Active Directory forests between two group companies to establish a unified identity management system.
Outcome
Architected and executed a fully automated, tool-based migration that completed the complex merger in just 20 days with zero errors and no end-user disruption.
The Ambition
A pioneer and industry leader in solar energy in India, part of a multi-billion dollar conglomerate.
The Challenge

Merging multiple Active Directory forests is an incredibly complex, time-consuming, and high-risk exercise. A manual migration was estimated to take several man-months and would be highly exposed to errors and data inconsistencies, which could have potentially disastrous consequences for user access and productivity.
The Architectural Blueprint

As part of a strategic move to achieve operational efficiency, the client's ambition was to seamlessly merge the IT operations of two distinct group companies. A successful integration required a flawless merger of their core identity systems to create a single, unified organization.
Ambition, Realized

The project was a stunning success. The entire complex migration was completed within a stringent deadline of just 20 days. The automated process was completely transparent to end-users, who saw no impact on their day-to-day operations. The migration was completed with zero errors, a feat nearly impossible with a manual approach. Our experience in large, demanding migration projects enabled us to deliver a fast, efficient, and completely risk-free outcome.
Key Business Impact
Completed a Complex AD Forest Merger in Just 20 Days
Achieved a Zero-Error, Zero End-User Disruption Migration
Mitigated Significant Business Risk with an Automated Approach
Enabled a Successful & Timely M&A Integration
